$comment: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) — simplest setup: Desktop spawns its own neuromcp over stdio. GUI apps are NOT launched from a login shell, so they usually have neither `node` nor `npx` on PATH: use absolute paths. Get yours with `which node` and `npm root -g` (then append /neuromcp/bin/neuromcp.mjs), or just run `npx neuromcp-init`, which writes this file for you.
